title: Chunk and Manifest Model
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Chunk and Manifest Model.
learning_objectives: Explain chunk and manifest model using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for chunk and manifest model

ChunkInfo/PutResult/Repository describe chunk metadata and stored content.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
